summary: For negative milliseconds with a nonzero remainder, casting that remainder to u32 before multiplication causes overflow or invalid nanoseconds. The fix handles negative inputs by subtracting one second and complementing the absolute remainder in nanoseconds. The fix extends the doctest in src/naive/datetime/mod.rs at line 143 with a -2208936075 millisecond round-trip assertion. This is the only upstream test calling from_timestamp_millis at this revision. Blocked: prototype/mine.py supports named library/integration tests but cannot select doctests, so test is empty. The implementation reversal is exact and unique; no tests were run.
